policy: Public pages must not render the retired low-quality educational diagram/infographic families. The rule applies whether an image is a current WordPress media attachment, an orphaned uploads URL, or a hardcoded source URL. Retired files may remain in source control only as historical/archive material; they must not be rendered on dtfseeds.com. A future replacement may bypass a family-name collision only when its media metadata contains DTF_APPROVED_PUBLIC_VISUAL.

notes: The C###, ENC-### and Outdoor-## educational image families are retired from all visitor-facing surfaces, regardless of whether WordPress still indexes the underlying upload as media.
Do not weaken a retirement rule merely to make a publisher pass. Replace the visual with an explicitly approved production asset instead.
The guard removes references from public WordPress content, clears retired featured media, and deletes a matched WordPress media attachment when production cleanup is enabled.
